rows.grounds: fused sandhi form of hiraṇyagarbhaṃ + vaṃde + ahaṃ
compound adjective modifying the bowed-to form
fused sandhi form of mama + iṣṭadam

items.question: Which named golden-womb form is bowed to as giver of desired boons?
premises: The devotee bows to a golden-womb form.
That form gives the devotee's desired boon.
items.inference: The verse identifies the bowed-to form as Manmatha, the golden-womb giver of desired boons.
uncertainties: The exact desired object is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: I bow to the golden-womb form named Manmatha, giver of my desired boon.
